mapper.select: -- 운영자 대시보드용 공고 입력과 승인 요청 현황을 집계한다. SELECT CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE a.approval_status_code = 'DRAFT' ) AS integer) AS draft_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE a.approval_status_code = 'REQUESTED' ) AS integer) AS requested_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE a.approval_status_code = 'APPROVED' AND a.manual_status_code = 'NORMAL' AND ( a.application_end_date IS NULL OR a.application_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE ) ) AS integer) AS open_announcement_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE a.manual_status_code IN ('PAUSED', 'SUSPENDED', 'HIDDEN') ) AS integer) AS paused_announcement_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE a.manual_status_code IN ('EARLY_CLOSED', 'BUDGET_EXHAUSTED', 'CLOSED') OR a.application_end_date < CURRENT_DATE ) AS integer) AS closed_announcement_count FROM announcements a

-- 운영자 대시보드용 매칭 업무 상태를 집계한다. SELECT CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE mc.status_code = 'MATCHED' ) AS integer) AS matched_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE mc.status_code = 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' ) AS integer) AS review_required_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE mc.status_code = 'BLOCKED' ) AS integer) AS blocked_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE mc.status_code = 'PROGRESSED' ) AS integer) AS progressed_count FROM matching_cases mc

-- 운영자 대시보드용 신청 진행 처리 현황과 수령 금액을 집계한다. SELECT CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE ap.status_code = 'READY' ) AS integer) AS ready_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE ap.status_code = 'IN_PROGRESS' ) AS integer) AS in_progress_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE ap.status_code = 'WAITING_RESULT' ) AS integer) AS waiting_result_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE ap.status_code = 'APPROVED' ) AS integer) AS approved_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE ap.status_code = 'SUPPLEMENT_REQUESTED' ) AS integer) AS supplement_requested_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE ap.status_code = 'STOPPED' ) AS integer) AS stopped_count, COALESCE( sum( CASE WHEN ap.received_amount IS NOT NULL AND ( ap.status_code IN ('APPROVED', 'COMPLETED') OR ap.result_code = 'APPROVED' ) THEN ap.received_amount ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS total_received_amount FROM application_progresses ap
